evidence: Refactors block script verification flow in validation.cpp and fixes script execution cache insertion in TestBlockValidity.
rationale: Unifies single-threaded and multi-threaded block script verification paths in ConnectBlock while fixing a long-standing omission in TestBlockValidity script cache population. Removing the dual-use inline/vector mode from CheckInputScripts eliminates an audit hazard in core block validation code, and ensuring the script cache is populated during multi-threaded TestBlockValidity avoids redundant execution.
